sections.Profile:
Captain Hook, released by Game Plan Inc. in April 1985, is a solid-state pinball machine with a pirate theme. Designed by Ed Cebula, the game features three flippers, two pop bumpers, two slingshots, eight standup targets, two banks of four drop targets, and a spinning target, offering players a dynamic and engaging experience. The artwork, created by Larry M. Blazek and Tom Schmelzer, complements the adventurous motif.
